subject.title: Feature request: calendar month-to-date option for the cost reporting period

question: Should CodexBar sponsor a persisted month-to-date cost period across the app, widgets, and CLI while retaining rolling days as the default?
rationale: The capability fits CodexBar’s spend-reporting mission, but it adds a new preference and a broad shared reporting contract that VISION.md says needs sign-off.

options.title: Approve shared period model
options.body: Sponsor a typed rolling-days/month-to-date abstraction across all reporting surfaces with cache, compatibility, localization, and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Narrow to explicit CLI mode
options.body: Support month-to-date only through an explicit CLI option and defer persisted app and widget behavior.

options.title: Retain rolling windows
options.body: Keep the existing numeric day-count model and leave calendar-month budgeting to exported data.

recommendation.title: Approve shared period model
recommendation.body: Sponsor a typed rolling-days/month-to-date abstraction across all reporting surfaces with cache, compatibility, localization, and upgrade coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history in the central cost aggregation, settings, and stale-result compatibility paths affected by this product choice.
